Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipe Lot - 15 Pieces
Estate Briar Wood & Mixed Materials
Vintage Estate Collection
A diverse collection of 15 vintage estate tobacco smoking pipes featuring classic bowl shapes, finishes, and stems. The grouping includes smooth briar, rustic carved and sandblast textures, a distinctive hand-stitched leather-wrapped bowl, and varied decorative acrylic and vulcanite stems.
Lot Highlights:
15 vintage estate pipes in various traditional shapes (billiard, bent, pot, and freehand profiles)
Assorted finishes including natural smooth grain, deeply rusticated, and stitched leather
Stems feature vulcanite, clear lucite, and amber-swirled acrylic designs
Visible maker stampings include Customcraft and other vintage hallmarks
Condition:

ctbids-49427-5792290.description: A graceful mix of mid-century American and Japanese fine china in soft whites, creams, and metallic accents, perfect for building out a wheat pattern collection or setting a classic holiday table. Featured is Kaysons Fine China Golden Rhapsody from Japan, a pattern dating to 1961 with delicate golden wheat sprays, along with Platinum Wheat Fine China from Japan showing slender silvery wheat stalks on bright white porcelain with platinum trim, including a serving platter, berry bowls, and a cup and saucer. Mikasa Narumi Spectrum 5504 fine china cups bring a crisp modern look with fine silver vertical striping, paired with cream saucers, while a large oval Kenmark China platter made in the USA and a Modern Star USA piece add more serving options with their warm ivory bodies and silver-tone rims. A cream stoneware creamer from Japan, marked dishwasher, oven, and microwave safe, adds an everyday-friendly accent, and the set is finished with soft white embroidered cotton napkins for a polished place setting. Please review all photos for details and condition of the items.

284048049.description:
Waterman Phileas Fountain Pen
Green Marble Finish with Gold-Plated Trim
France, With Original Box, Converter & Cartridge
The Waterman Phileas is an iconic writing instrument crafted in France, inspired by the 1930s Art Deco era and named in honor of Jules Verne's adventurer Phileas Fogg. It features a rich mineral green marbled barrel paired with polished black accents and ornate gold-plated appointments, including the distinctive Art Deco fan motif band and stepped pocket clip. Widely celebrated for its balanced weight and reliable performance, the Phileas remains a favorite among fountain pen enthusiasts.
Green marbled resin barrel and cap with gold-plated trim and black end caps
Two-tone nib featuring Waterman Paris hexagon hallmark and Art Deco geometric detailing
Art Deco styled pocket clip and decorative fan-motif barrel accent band
Cartridge/converter filling mechanism; includes piston converter and ink cartridge
Complete with original Waterman Paris blue presentation display box
Condition:
Barrel and cap are clean with lustrous resin and no cracks, chips, or deep scratches. Gold-plated trim and clip remain bright with minimal surface wear. Nib tines and tipping are straight and intact. Feed fins are clean. Presentation box is structurally intact with light exterior shelf wear.
